_comment: ZeRO-2: shards optimizer state and gradients across GPUs. Default choice - lowest communication overhead. Note what it does NOT do: it never shards base weights, at any precision, so the previous claim that it was 'sufficient for an 8B base held in 4-bit' misattributed the saving. Under LoRA it shards ~1.5GB of adapter optimizer state and is close to a no-op; it is the default because it is cheap, not because it rescues VRAM. When VRAM is the constraint, ZeRO-3 is the lever - see zero3.json.
